name: goalspec
description: Shape vague intent into clearer product direction with Option Maps, then produce Probe Packs and right-sized context/docs capture after convergence.

interface.shortDescription: Map options, converge direction, and generate execution probes.
interface.longDescription: GoalSpec is a decision-funnel skill. It turns vague intent into Option Maps, captures durable decisions under context/docs only after convergence, and prepares Probe Packs or Probe Notes with acceptance examples, non-goals, safe defaults, and final source-review checks before execution.
defaultPrompt: Use $authoring-goals to explore this vague request as an Option Map with tradeoffs and a recommendation.
Use $authoring-goals to capture the chosen direction under context/docs/ and include the Probe Pack needed for execution.
Use $authoring-goals to prepare a Probe Note for this known change without creating durable docs.
